owner_scope: Edit seven existing PNGs only; preserve people, faces, poses, lighting and background. No video launches or queue additions.
method: Built-in imagegen existing-image edit; only approved local patch footprints composited onto original pixels. Official CPK/Roscosmos artwork substituted for ambiguous small AI lettering; wall/name text kept exact. Full generated frames were not used as replacements.
